title: Symbol gallery and schematic editing
status: gate met — catalog, filters, preview, assignment with undo, rejected custom catalog and default restore

implementation.bridge: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.WellTools/Bridging/OgSymbolGallery.cs (rows, categories, summary, preview, assign, catalog state)
implementation.tools: TheTechIdea.OilGas.WellSchematic — SymbolCatalog, SymbolRenderer, WellModelConverter.SymbolFor, SchematicTrack plan cache

gates.AC-1 the gallery reports the loaded symb: pass — 235 symbols in 15 categories, counted from SymbolCatalog.Current, and reported in the summary and the smoke run
gates.AC-2 filtering by category and by search: pass — a category filter returns only that category and fewer than the whole catalog; search matches an id, a name fragment and an abbreviation case-insensitively; both filters combine; a search that matches nothing returns nothing
gates.AC-3 an assignment change is visible on: pass — OgSymbolGallery.Assign changes the equipment's symbol id and records the previous one; after WellboreView.CommitDocumentChanges the rendered frame differs from the frame before the change (the layout is cached against the view document's revision, so an in-place edit must be committed — a real finding)
gates.AC-4 undo restores the previous symbol: pass — the history entry's undo action restores the previous id, and after committing and re-rendering the frame is byte-identical to the original
gates.AC-5 an invalid custom catalog is reject: pass — a parse failure propagates to the page, which reports it and keeps the active catalog (the same instance is still in place); a catalog that parses but holds no symbols is refused with catalog-empty and the active catalog is untouched
gates.AC-6 the default catalog is restored by: pass — OgSymbolCatalogState.RestoreDefault sets SymbolCatalog.Default and the source back to default; after a custom catalog of one symbol the restore returns more than 100

limits: The assignment UI targets a component chosen from a list; select-on-the-drawing, move, resize and delete are not implemented.
There is no file picker: LoadCustom takes a path and the page exposes the method; the toolbar button for importing a file is still to come.
Assigning a symbol that the catalog does not contain is allowed by the model (the tools draw their generic symbol); the page picks from the catalog so this cannot happen through the UI.
The preview is rendered on demand for the selected row at 96x96; there is no size control.
The demo's symbol set is the tools' own 235; no customer catalog was exercised beyond a one-symbol round trip.
